# Best Sabah

> A local guide to Kota Kinabalu and Sabah, Malaysia. Written by a Sabahan who was born here and never had a reason to leave. No sponsored content, no press trips. Just honest recommendations from someone who actually lives here.

## About
- [About Best Sabah](https://bestsabah.com/about.html): About the author, a lifelong Sabahan writing about food, places, and real life in KK.

## Posts

### Things To Do
- [Best Shopping Mall in Kota Kinabalu: Imago](https://bestsabah.com/posts/best-shopping-mall-kota-kinabalu-imago.html): Imago at KK Times Square is the best shopping mall in Kota Kinabalu. Uniqlo, GSC cinema, food street, and parking is rarely a problem. All you need to know.
- [Mount Kinabalu Climbing Guide 2026](https://bestsabah.com/posts/climbing-mount-kinabalu-guide.html): Mount Kinabalu climbing guide for first-timers (2026). How to book, cost breakdown, Kampung Adidas shoes, training tips, and what 4,095m really feels like.
- [Hiking Bukit Padang, Kota Kinabalu](https://bestsabah.com/posts/hiking-bukit-padang-kk.html): Bukit Padang trail in Taman Botani KK is free, takes about 40 minutes up, and ends with a full panoramic view of Kota Kinabalu. Everything you need to know.

### Best Food
- [Best Chicken Rice in KK: Andrew Wong](https://bestsabah.com/posts/andrew-wong-chicken-rice.html): The best chicken rice in Kota Kinabalu. Andrew Wong in Damai serves big portions, amazing ginger sauce, and chicken with real flavour. Our honest review.
- [Best Bak Kut Teh in KK: Yu Kee, Jalan Gaya](https://bestsabah.com/posts/best-bak-kut-teh-kota-kinabalu.html): Yu Kee on Jalan Gaya serves KK's best herbal bak kut teh. Tender pork, free soup refill, dark sweet soy on the side. Open daily 2:15pm. Around RM36 per person.
- [Best Guo Tie in Kota Kinabalu: Ching Jie](https://bestsabah.com/posts/best-guo-tie-dumplings-kota-kinabalu.html): Ching Jie Dumpling in Foh Sang serves KK's best guo tie. Crispy wrapper, juicy pork, hand-wrapped and fried to order. RM12 for 10. A locals-only spot.
- [Best Seafood in Kota Kinabalu: Sasa Seafood](https://bestsabah.com/posts/best-seafood-kota-kinabalu.html): Looking for the best seafood in Kota Kinabalu? Sasa Seafood in Penampang delivers on price, portion, and taste. Here's why locals keep coming back.
- [DESA Ice Cream in KK: DESAMOO at Damai Plaza](https://bestsabah.com/posts/desa-ice-cream-kk.html): DESA ice cream is now available in Kota Kinabalu at DESAMOO, inside DESA Fresh Mart at Damai Plaza Luyang. No need to drive 2 hours to Kundasang anymore.
- [Best Tenom Mee in Kota Kinabalu: Towering](https://bestsabah.com/posts/towering-tenom-mee-kota-kinabalu.html): Best tenom mee in Kota Kinabalu. Towering Tenom Mee: fried noodles in silky egg gravy with fatty char siew. Cheap, big portions, packed with locals.
- [Best Tamparuli Mee in Kota Kinabalu: Weng Foh](https://bestsabah.com/posts/weng-foh-tamparuli-mee-kota-kinabalu.html): Best tamparuli mee in Kota Kinabalu at Weng Foh, Damai. Fried noodles with egg, char siew and egg rolls. Better than the original, no Tamparuli drive needed.
- [Best Ngiu Chap in Kota Kinabalu: Yii Siang](https://bestsabah.com/posts/yii-siang-beef-noodle-kk.html): Best ngiu chap in Kota Kinabalu. Yii Siang in Inanam: Hainanese beef noodle from RM14, laksa from RM16. Free parking. Open daily from 6:30am.

### Sports
- [Best Badminton Shop in KK: AST Sports Centre](https://bestsabah.com/posts/best-badminton-shop-kota-kinabalu-ast-sports-centre.html): AST Sports Centre is the best badminton shop in Kota Kinabalu. Great stringing, cheap prices, all major brands. At the Foochow building. Opens 10am daily.

### Lifestyle
- [Sabahans Building Things Worth Knowing](https://bestsabah.com/posts/sabahans-building-things-worth-knowing.html): A few Sabah businesses quietly doing good work: a 24-hour clinic, a scaffolding supplier, an eco-tour crew, and a Kota Kinabalu web design studio.
